title: SiloCertificateExpiringV0
description:
An alert indicating that the TLS certificate served for a silo's external API is about to expire, and no later-expiring certificate is installed for that silo.

Nexus serves the silo's certificate with the latest expiration time. Once a certificate with a later expiration time is uploaded for the silo, this condition is resolved.

time.description: The time at which the condition was evaluated.

AlertCertificate.description: Describes the certificate involved in a certificate alert.

not_after.description: The time after which the certificate is no longer valid.

AlertSilo.description: Describes the silo involved in a certificate alert.

Name.title: A name unique within the parent collection
Name.description: Names must begin with a lower case ASCII letter, be composed exclusively of lowercase ASCII, uppercase ASCII, numbers, and '-', and may not end with a '-'. Names cannot be a UUID, but they may contain a UUID. They can be at most 63 characters long.
